'''Mahl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squad led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nova Stihl]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was on duty when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] liberated [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]] on [[Deck 5|Level 5]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Sergeant Stihl ordered Mahl to take the lead in the squad's attempt to capture the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] before they could escape. He presumably perished during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was first named in [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], although there is no indication which trooper he was, as depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
